title: Analista de RH Sênior - Remuneração
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar de forma estratégica e integrada na gestão dos subsistemas de Recursos Humanos, com foco em remuneração fixa e variável, desempenho, metas e competências. Contribuir para a revisão, evolução e governança dos modelos de remuneração variável para diferentes níveis da organização, assegurando alinhamento à estratégia corporativa, à equidade interna, à competitividade externa e às tendências de mercado. Apoiar a liderança por meio de análises, indicadores, relatórios e recomendações que fortaleçam o sistema de gestão de pessoas de forma sistêmica.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atividades a serem executadas:

  • Revisar, estruturar e acompanhar os modelos de remuneração variável, assegurando alinhamento às estratégias organizacionais, metas e níveis de complexidade dos cargos;
  • Apoiar a governança dos processos de avaliação de desempenho, metas e competências, garantindo integração entre os subsistemas de RH;
  • Conduzir análises e pesquisas de mercado (benchmarking e pesquisas salariais), propondo ajustes e recomendações;
  • Realizar avaliação e revisão de cargos, bem como manutenção de tabelas salariais, promovendo equidade interna e competitividade externa;
  • Apoiar a revisão e administração dos programas de benefícios;
  • Desenvolver análises orçamentárias e relatórios de custos de pessoal;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, indicadores e dashboards para apoio à liderança;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com os demais subsistemas de RH, fortalecendo a visão sistêmica da gestão de pessoas;
  • Apoio e elaboração do programa anual de avaliação de desempenho: Progressão e Promoção.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduação completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Engenharia de Produção, Gestão de Pessoas, Processos ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência Profissional e Conhecimentos Técnicos necessários:

  • Vivência consistente em subsistemas de Recursos Humanos (perfil multiskill) – como avaliação por competência; benefícios; entre outros;
  • Atuação relevante em remuneração, cargos e salários e programas de incentivos;
  • Experiência na revisão e/ou estruturação de modelos de remuneração variável (curto e longo prazo), considerando diferentes níveis organizacionais;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de avaliação de desempenho, gestão de metas e competências;
  • Atuação com indicadores de RH, KPIs e análises para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Experiência em desenho, revisão e implementação de projetos de RH com visão end-to-end;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e construção de dashboards (diferencial);
  • Vivência com People Analytics e análises quantitativas aplicadas à gestão de pessoas;
  • Experiência com descrição, avaliação e arquitetura de cargos.

Conhecimento Técnico:

  • Domínio de metodologias de avaliação de cargos (ex.: Mercer, Hay ou similares);
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de pesquisas salariais e estudos de mercado;
  • Conhecimento de práticas e tendências de remuneração e gestão de desempenho.

Desejável:

  • Pós-graduação e/ou MBA em Remuneração, Gestão de Pessoas, Estratégia, Finanças ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimentos em gestão de processos e projetos;
  • Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.

Informações adicionais

Faixa salarial: R$ 8.861,13

Local de trabalho: Trabalho híbrido no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Coordenador (a) de projeto.

Descrição resumida do cargo

O Coordenador (a) de projeto terá a responsabilidade de implementar o projeto Apoio a Distância na comunidade Morro dos Cabritos e implementar as atividades referentes a esse programa. Além disso deverá participar dos eventos comunitários que serão realizados em parceria com uma empresa patrocinadora e executar ações pontuais de promoção social.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades do cargo

  • Apoiar a realização pontual de eventos comunitários que AVSI está realizando em parceria com uma empresa patrocinadora.
  • Organizar o trabalho do projeto Apoio a Distância (SAD) que irá começar no Morro dos Cabritos em Copacabana.
  • Elaborar diagnóstico social de famílias e comunidades em situação de vulnerabilidade adequadamente e promover a elaboração, implementação e monitoramento de planos de acompanhamento familiar.
  • Promover o acesso a direitos sociais e políticas públicas (assistência, saúde, educação, habitação).
  • Articular as famílias com a rede socioassistencial e intersetorial (CRAS, CREAS, escolas, unidades de saúde, Judiciário).
  • Elaborar relatórios sociais, pareceres técnicos e estudos de caso.
  • Planejar e executar ações socioeducativas e preventivas.
  • Acompanhar e monitorar indicadores sociais ligados à realização dos planos de acompanhamento familiar.

title: Software Engineer - Cloud Images
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to work on Linux, cloud infrastructure, pipelines and automation, and open source software.

You will work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to make Ubuntu the best platform there is in the clouds. Your time will be split between build system development (using Python, Jenkins and shell), implementation of cloud-related features within Ubuntu Server itself, operation of our continuous delivery pipelines, and direct partner engagement. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers, and integrate our products with cloud native services.

What the role entails

  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Design, build and integrate new features and enhancements into Ubuntu that will support users of Ubuntu in public clouds
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Design and architect complex new systems and integrations with the clouds
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers and participate in design discussions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have practical experience with public clouds
  • You have interest and experience with at least 3 of the following: containers (docker, kubernetes, etc.), devops automation, open source projects, APIs, Linux systems administration, Python packaging, cloud-based applications
  • at least experience in Python software development on Linux

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.

  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast‑paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area‑related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross‑functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Expected Salary Range

$110,000 - $125,000

Realiza patrulhamento preventivo, tanto interno quanto externo, nas dependências da empresa, com o objetivo de garantir a segurança de colaboradores, visitantes e do patrimônio da organização. Durante as rondas, é responsável por identificar comportamentos suspeitos e agir de forma preventiva para evitar furtos, danos materiais ou outras situações que representem risco à integridade do ambiente.

Em situações de emergência, atua com agilidade, prestando os primeiros socorros quando necessário e acionando os órgãos competentes, como polícia, bombeiros ou atendimento médico.

Além disso, realiza o registro de ocorrências e incidentes em relatórios diários, detalhando as ações tomadas, horários, envolvidos e demais informações relevantes para o histórico e acompanhamento da segurança da empresa. Por fim, zela pelo cumprimento rigoroso de todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança estabelecidos, assegurando a ordem, o bom funcionamento das operações e a integridade do ambiente corporativo.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Ensino médio completo (obrigatório).

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releasees and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross-functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow-up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Expected Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000

title: Machinist Technician BRA
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network. Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

This position is responsible for the operation of machinery that performs machining in metallic structures. Planning, turning, drilling, and grinding are examples of machinery processes that are part of the work scope under the Machinery Technician responsibility.

  • Works on machinery workshop handling all machining process to support aircraft maintenance heavy check
  • Fabrication, grinding and repair of metal structures is part of the regular job accountabilities
  • Operate lathe machine and measure work pieces verifying dimensions using appropriate tools
  • Be familiar with boring, drilling, reaming, threading, and tapping operations
  • Detecting malfunctions, replacing worn tools, cleaning debris from machine
  • Report any faulty operation of equipment or defective materials to the area supervisor
  • Operate lifting devices for movement of materials and other equipment as needed
  • Be familiar with the preparation of tools for machining
  • Load feed mechanism by lifting stock into position
  • Maintain specifications by observing drilling, grooving, and cutting, including turning, facing, and threading
  • Responsible for keeping equipment and work area clean and orderly
  • Verify settings by measuring positions, first-run parts, and sample work pieces
  • Professionalism, integrity and work ethic while possessing a visionary skill set that will successfully carry the team into the future.
  • Must comply with Brazilian Norm NR -12 training and certification

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High school diploma or equivalent in Machining Operation technical course with emphasis in planning, turning, drilling, and grinding
  • Local driver’s license
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship
  • Previous NR-1
  • 3 years’ experience in aeronautical industry
  • Must have extensive knowledge of machinery operation with emphasis on the aeronautical industry
  • Must have experience operating lathe machine, milling machine, vertical and horizontal band saw, drill and tread machine, hydraulic press and oven operation for heat treatment
  • Mechanical problem-solving ability and troubleshooting skills a must
  • Must be able to read a tape measure, verify dimensions, use a straightedge and other measuring devices
  • Have the knowledge of machine drawings, fit and tolerances
  • Must be able to operate lifting devices
  • Must be able to read and understand work instructions, drawings, technical manuals and standards in English.
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

title: Global Head of GSI Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We have created a new senior leadership role, Head of Global System Integrator (GSI) Alliances, to lead our business development and partnership with these important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we are expanding into the enterprise market where GSIs provide significant operational and tactical capacity. We have had good success with GSIs that are delivering next‑generation private cloud, container, and public cloud solutions built with Canonical Ubuntu, and are looking to expand our investment in these alliances.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Global Head of GSI Alliances will lead a team of representatives and develop that strategic go‑to‑market strength for Canonical. You will work closely with GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open‑source solutions at scale for their enterprise customers. In this role you will be responsible for ensuring that our solutions are used or embedded at the core of GSI digital transformation platforms.

Our GSI team builds trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increases Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizes the partnership and leads all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. The Global Head of GSI Alliances will own the strategy, sell‑to, sell‑through and sell‑with motions with all GSI partners, as well as promotion of our GSI‑related activities – from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and GSI‑related events (including Canonical's yearly GSI executive summit).

Location: Our company largely works from home; this role can be based in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Own and drive GSI partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical
  • Lead and evolve a team towards accelerated revenue growth with GSI
  • Build strategic relationships with partners at executive levels
  • Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in alliance and indirect sales management roles
  • Experience in the GSI sector
  • Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue and margins
  • Proven leadership and presentation skills
  • Insight into open source, Ubuntu and Canonical's competition and opportunities
  • Track record of data‑driven decision‑making
  • An autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About Retrouvai

Retrouvai ( is a globally recognized luxury fine jewelry brand based in Los Angeles known for bold design, exceptional gemstones, and modern heirlooms. Our pieces are worn by leading celebrities and sold through premier retailers and luxury destinations worldwide, including Paris, London, Dubai, and Morocco.

We are a founder‑led, design‑driven company experiencing strong growth. As we scale, we are building a disciplined financial infrastructure to support long‑term success.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Accountant to take full ownership of our accounting function (remote).

This is not a support role.

You will be the sole accounting resource for the company, responsible for maintaining clean, accurate books and ensuring the financial foundation of the business is strong, organized, and reliable.

You will work directly with the founders and have full visibility into the financial operations of a global luxury brand.

What You Will Own

You will be responsible for managing the entire accounting function, including:

Core Accounting

  • Maintain the general ledger in QuickBooks Online
  • Record all financial transactions accurately and on time
  • Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and vendor payments
  • Manage Accounts Receivable (AR), including invoicing and collections

Monthly Close & Reporting

  • Own and execute the monthly close process
  • Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
  • Deliver a clean monthly reporting package to leadership
  • Identify and explain key financial trends and variances

Payroll & Compliance

  • Manage payroll through QuickBooks Online / Gusto
  • Ensure payroll taxes and filings are completed accurately and on time
  • Support onboarding/offboarding from an HR and payroll perspective

Inventory & Cost Accounting (Important)

  • Maintain accurate inventory accounting (raw materials, WIP, finished goods)
  • Track cost of goods sold (COGS) and gross margins
  • Ensure proper flow of costs through inventory to financial statements

Systems & Process Ownership

  • Establish and maintain clean, scalable accounting processes
  • Improve workflows and introduce automation where appropriate
  • Coordinate with external CPA for year‑end tax filings

What We're Looking For

This role requires someone who can operate independently and take full ownership.

Required

  • 5+ years of accounting or full‑charge bookkeeping experience
  • Strong experience with QuickBooks Online
  • Experience managing full monthly close independently
  • Hands‑on experience with AR, AP, and reconciliations
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to communicate clearly in English (written and verbal)

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with inventory‑based or product businesses
  • Experience managing accounting as the sole or primary accountant
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies
  • Background in public accounting or CPA track

What Success Looks Like

  • Books are clean, accurate, and always up to date
  • Monthly close is completed on time without supervision
  • Financial reports are clear, organized, and insightful
  • AR is actively managed and collections are followed up consistently
  • Founders have confidence in the financials without needing to dig

Compensation

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Performance‑based bonus tied to accuracy, timeliness, and financial operations
  • Fully remote role with flexibility

  • Experience in other business functions and field operation will be a plus.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de quatro (a) Engenheiros (Sênior) para atuar na Gerência de Estruturação de Dados Técnicos para o BPR e RTP do Sistema de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica da companhia, com foco em assegurar a consistência dos dados técnicos e regulatórios no âmbito da revisão do BPR e da RTP, a qual é fundamental para garantir os retornos dos investimentos realizados pela companhia sob responsabilidade da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia e Expansão (VEE).

Este(a) profissional será responsável por coordenar os levantamentos dos dados técnicos e memórias de cálculos para os projetos de reforços e melhorias que irão subsidiar a revisão do Banco de Preços de Referência e a Revisão Tarifária Periódica, avaliando critérios técnicos, regulatórios e econômico-financeiros, de forma a subsidiar a correta alocação e garantir os objetivos corporativos da Axia Energia.

Responsabilidades

  • Levantar dados técnicos contratuais referentes aos equipamentos por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais.

  • Identificar as possíveis necessidades de cadastros no SGPMR/O.N.S, quando não previstas no projeto inicial, e após terem sido confirmadas pela regulação e classificadas como item extrapatrimonial, e encaminhar o levantamento para a área responsável na engenharia por esses cadastros.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Engenharia, preferencialmente elétrica e civil.

  • Conhecimento dos procedimentos e normativos da ANEEL e do ONS relacionados a reforços e melhorias (Módulo 2 dos Procedimentos de Rede, REN 905/2020 e correlatas).
  • Conhecimento do Módulo 9: Concessionárias de Transmissão Submódulo 9.1 REVISÃO PERIÓDICA DAS RECEITAS DAS CONCESSIONÁRIAS DE TRANSMISSÃO
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e análise de portfólio e projetos (Excel avançado, SAP, Power BI, MS Project).
  • Capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de interação com diferentes áreas técnicas e níveis hierárquicos.

Diferenciais

VTEX é a plataforma de comércio completa que proporciona mais eficiência e menos manutenção para organizações que buscam fazer investimentos mais inteligentes em TI e modernizar sua estrutura de tecnologia. Através da nossa abordagem pragmática, capacitamos marcas, distribuidores e varejistas com uma flexibilidade incomparável e soluções abrangentes, permitindo que invistam apenas no que oferece uma vantagem clara para o negócio e aumenta a lucratividade.

A VTEX é confiada por 2.400 clientes globais B2C e B2B, incluindo Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker e Whirlpool, operando 3.400 lojas online ativas em 43 países (dados do ano fiscal encerrado em 31 de dezembro de 2024).

Fundada no ano 2000, a VTEX tem uma trajetória de crescimento imbatível. Desafiando todas as probabilidades, estamos liderando a indústria de alta tecnologia e nos posicionando acima de gigantes do mercado. Estamos construindo um futuro extraordinário com mais de 1.300 colaboradores distribuídos por 25 localidades em 16 países da América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia. Na VTEX, você trabalhará em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, colaborando com colegas incríveis. Se você tem força individual, junte-se a nós e, juntos, seremos imparáveis.

INCLUSÃO E ACESSIBILIDADE

Na VTEX, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que a inclusão é essencial para o nosso sucesso. Esta vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) como parte do nosso compromisso em promover um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. Acreditamos na geração de oportunidades como ferramenta de mudança e estamos focados em encontrar talentos diversos para nossos times! Estamos comprometidos em adaptar nossas instalações e ferramentas para garantir a acessibilidade de todos os nossos colaboradores, bem como dos candidatos do processo seletivo. Se você precisar de alguma adequação especial para participar do nosso processo seletivo, por favor, nos informe.

Essa é nosso banco de talentos de Diversidade, focado em Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência. Nosso time de Recrutamento está constantemente revisando os currículos que chegarem por aqui, e quando identificamos uma ótima oportunidade, entramos em contato com as pessoas para que elas participem do nosso processo de recrutamento.

Quem pode se inscrever?

Todas as pessoas com deficiência podem se inscrever nessa página e em qualquer outra vaga na nossa página de carreiras. Aqui, seu perfil será revisado e, se houver compatibilidade, encaminhado para áreas nas quais estamos contratando. Caso você não se identifique como uma pessoa com deficiência, confira nossas outras oportunidades na página de carreiras da VTEX.

Social Work

Dean, School of Social Work

Position Summary

The School of Social Work seeks candidates for two open-rank faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor), with rank determined based on qualifications and experience. Successful candidates will be responsible for teaching, research and scholarship, and service consistent with the mission of the institution and the accreditation standards of the Council on Social Work Education. Research and Scholarship

  • Develop and/or execute a focused scholarly research agenda

Service

  • Participate in school and institutional service
  • Engage in professional and community service activities

Required Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree (PhD or DSW) in Social Work or related field by time of appointment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent teaching evaluations and experience teaching online

For consideration, submit a letter of interest outlining research, teaching, service, and practice experiences along with a curriculum vita and two samples of scholarly work. Applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.

title: Transmission Manager
description:
The Role

What is the role?

You will be part of a team supporting renewable development efforts. Primarily your responsibilities will be to execute studies evaluating and assessing the feasibility of renewable power and/or energy storage projects.

You will also:

  • Provide a strategic view on grid connections for future projects
  • Setup and maintain models required for performing in-house studies typically focused on renewable power and/or energy storage projects
  • Gather power system data and maintain internal databases for use in power system studies in focus areas
  • Monitor changes to power systems (e.g., new generation, generation retirements, transmission upgrades, new demand, energy efficiency programs, demand response programs), gather associated data and update simulation databases as needed
  • Prepare inputs for studies
  • Perform simulations under managerial supervision
  • Gather, analyze and summarize results of simulations. The latter may involve writing reports, preparing and delivering presentation, preparing excel spreadsheets, etc.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant grid codes
  • Team player, working with the team, as well as the larger organization
  • Assist with similar tasks in other regions of the world
  • Assist/coordinate the work of outside consultants

What we need from you

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer.
  • Bachelor's Degree in electrical engineering or other relevant discipline preferred. Master Degree or PhD preferred
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Additional experience preferred
  • Several years of experience with transmission planning models such as PSS/E, PSLF, DIgSILENT, ETAP, Aspen
  • Experience within, or working with relevant functions at the ISO/RTO/TP/TNO/DNO level
  • Experience with MV and HV work; substation engineering
  • Significant experience with power system modeling methods such as demand forecasting, security constrained economic dispatch (SCED), security constrained unit commitment (SCUC), power flow, optimal power flow
  • Proficient in preparation of technical reports and technical presentations
  • Strong collaboration and problem-solving skills, capable of applying advanced power systems engineering principles to identify and solve complex issues
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships within a complex, global corporation: some corporate stamina is required
  • Reports to the Global Head of Transmission Strategy
  • Availability to travel 20% of the time primarily domestic travel
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages a plus
  • Kindly submit your resume in both Portuguese and English.

Potential Location(s) for Resourcing: Sao Paulo, Rio or virtual.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
This posting is for 2 roles of Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing – Experience Stills (LATAM).

Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing – Experience Stills (LATAM)

Role Overview

The Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing – Experience (LATAM) is responsible for leading the design, development, and execution of integrated, end-to-end marketing experiences across assigned brands or categories in Latin America.

Operating at the intersection of planning, creativity, media, and execution , this role translates brand and business strategies into coherent consumer and shopper experiences that connect meaningfully across all touchpoints. The Senior Manager plays a critical role in ensuring creative excellence, experience consistency, and strong cross‑functional orchestration—bringing marketing plans to life in ways that drive relevance, conversion, and growth.

This role requires a strategic thinker with creative mindset and strong executional rigor —someone who can turn insights into clear creative challenges, manage complexity, and lead agencies and internal teams to deliver impactful work.

Key Responsibilities

1. Integrated Planning & Consumer Experience

  • Lead the development ofend-to-end experience strategies for assigned brands or categories, aligned with broader regional and global direction.
  • Translate business and category objectives intoclear creative and experience briefs , grounded in consumer and shopper insights.
  • Design marketing plans around theconsumer journey and shopper path , ensuring continuity and effectiveness across touchpoints.
  • Contribute to long‑term experience platforms, while ensuring strong execution of annual and campaign plans.

2. Creative Strategy & Execution

  • Partner with Brand, Category, and Creative Strategy teams to shapecreative territories and communication strategies .
  • Develop high‑quality creative briefs and lead agencies through ideation, development, and refinement.
  • Apply creative judgment tochallenge, guide, and elevate ideas , ensuring work is on‑brand, culturally relevant, and effective.
  • Ensure consistency of brand storytelling across content, channels, and markets.
  • Support the amplification ofGlobal Core Creative Ideas into relevant LATAM executions.

3. End‑to‑End Orchestration & Delivery

  • Take ownership of assigned initiativesfrom planning through execution , ensuring alignment, prioritization, and timely delivery.
  • Orchestrate cross‑functional teams including media, digital, design, consumer & shopper engagement, and commercial partners.
  • Manage agency relationships (creative, media, production), ensuring clarity of scope, quality output, and efficiency.
  • Balance ambition withtimelines, budgets, and resources , escalating risks and trade‑offs as needed.
  • Ensure coherence and integration across all consumer connection points.

4. Media, Digital & Performance Orientation

  • Collaborate with media, digital, and DAO teams to ensure plans reflectevolving media behaviors, e‑commerce, and platform dynamics .
  • Support performance tracking, measurement, and learning agendas.
  • Analyze campaign and experience results, translating insights intooptimization and future planning inputs .
  • Contribute to improving ROI and effectiveness of integrated marketing investments.

5. Collaboration, Influence & Leadership

  • Act as a key connector between Brand, Category, IMX, E2E, Media, and Commercial teams.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, providing recommendations and rationale.
  • Lead specific workstreams or project teams; mentor junior team members where applicable.
  • Build strong working relationships with bottlers and external partners.
  • Collaborate with OU and global counterparts to ensure alignment and best‑practice sharing.

Organizational Impact

  • Owns delivery ofdefined initiatives and workstreams within integrated marketing plans.
  • Contributes to operational planning and execution within an established strategic framework.
  • Influences decisions related to project plans, sequencing, and resource use within assigned scope.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in marketing, integrated marketing, and creative strategy, including hands‑on experience working with or within agency environments.
  • Experience inconsumer and shopper marketing ; CPG experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and executeintegrated marketing and experience strategies .
  • Strong understanding ofdigital ecosystems, media, culture, and content development .
  • Experience working with external agencies and cross‑functional internal teams.
  • Proven ability to manage complexity, prioritize effectively, and deliver high‑quality work.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on iconic, category‑leading brands.
  • Exposure to integrated, end‑to‑end marketing strategy and execution at scale.
  • A collaborative, creative environment that values curiosity, craft, and consumer‑centricity.
  • Strong partnership with regional and global teams and world‑class agencies.
  • A role that builds depth and readiness for future Director‑level leadership.

Descrição da vaga

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Garantir a execução da estratégia da nova plataforma de vídeos verticais da Globo, maximizando valor para usuários, anunciantes e produtores de conteúdo, por meio de decisões orientadas a dados, excelência em experiência e forte articulação com áreas especialistas;
  • Equilibrar crescimento de audiência, experiência do usuário, eficiência de monetização e otimização de custos em um ambiente de múltiplos stakeholders. Influenciar times especialistas que atuam em múltiplos produtos, sem gestão direta. Garantir clareza estratégica e velocidade de execução em produtos de alta exposição e relevância. Manter os produtos atualizados frente às rápidas transformações do mercado de entretenimento digital;
  • Executar a estratégia do produto sob a ótica de negócio, marca e experiência, garantindo coerência com os objetivos estratégicos;
  • Ser responsável pelo desempenho financeiro, atuando junto às áreas comercial e financeira na identificação de oportunidades de monetização, eficiência de custo e otimização de margem;
  • Monitorar indicadores-chave da plataforma, identificando riscos, perdas de desempenho e oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Atuar como especialista da experiência do produto, sendo referência nos fluxos de navegação, pontos de fricção, diferenciais competitivos e oportunidades de evolução;
  • Garantir o alinhamento do backlog de produto aos objetivos estratégicos do produto;
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de marca e posicionamento dos produtos, tanto para o público consumidor quanto para o mercado anunciante;
  • Acompanhar tendências de consumo de entretenimento digital, pesquisas de comportamento e movimentações de mercado;
  • Monitorar iniciativas de concorrentes e benchmarks, analisando resultados e propondo planos de resposta ou adaptação estratégica;
  • Gerir diretamente o times dedicado ao produto;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com os líderes de Tecnologia, Marketing, Conteúdo, Inteligência e Comercial;
  • Articular parcerias estratégicas que contribuam para crescimento, inovação e fortalecimento do produto.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência prévia com Produtos Digitais: buscamos alguém com experiência prévia de atuação direta em produtos digitais. Precisa ser uma pessoa com familiaridade com arquitetura de produto, priorização de backlog de desenvolvimento, mecânica de recomendação e arquitetura de dados;
  • Superior Completo, mas a formação não é restritiva: pode ser Administração, Engenharia, Comunicação;
  • Inglês intermediário;

  • Conhecimentos sobre Experiência do Usuário (UX) e arquitetura de produto: domínio de fluxos, navegação e diferenciação entre plataformas;
  • Visão analítica, orientada a dados e centrada no usuário para tomada de decisão;
  • Compreensão de modelos de monetização de plataformas e produtos digitais, com foco em publicidade;
  • Boa capacidade de organização, priorização e comunicação com stakeholders.

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central liaison to FIFA Zurich, facilitating alignment on strategic priorities, reporting, and operational updates
  • Provide hands‑on support and guidance to the local team, ensuring they have the resources, information, and leadership needed to deliver high‑quality operational outcomes
  • Support and build accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for FIFA tournament venues of the host country
  • Manage and oversee the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories, seat allocations and carry out required updates
  • Maintain on day‑to‑day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
  • Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and proposes corrective measures
  • Carry out the seat allocation and seat assignment process in the ticketing system
  • Assess and analyse maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
  • Plan, prepare and carry out onsite seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
  • Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measure for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
  • Administer allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
  • 5 years of professional experience
  • 1-3 years of experience in ticketing or similar functional area (first experiences in creating seating maps or floorplans in a software application of advantage)
  • Experience in data analytics and/ or management
  • Onsite ticketing operations experience
  • Experience in working with CAD technical drawings
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across functional areas such as security, broadcasting, hospitality
  • Strong analytical skills, detail‑oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Accessibility Manager
description:
Accessibility Manager

Department: Social Responsibility & Education

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager works alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reports to the Head of Sustainability. The role is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services. As the Tournament draws closer, the role will evolve from planning into operations, resulting in an assignment to a competition or non‑competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to:
  • Ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including auditing official sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements and ensuring improvements are implemented.
  • Work with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Develop and deliver accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.

Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that:

  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team:

  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti‑Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • Deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leverage the unique value of mega‑sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with national and international accessibility standards for disabled people.
  • 5+ years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes.
  • Experience in a comparable role in an international, fast‑paced environment and complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritisation and independent work.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools.

Additional Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, equality, diversity and/or international relations.
  • In‑depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega‑sporting events.
  • Experience developing and delivering capacity‑building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience in sustainability performance management, reporting and communications.
  • Experience working in sports and/or events.
  • International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with the ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well‑organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Strong relationship‑building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity to interact with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

You can expect a highly knowledgeable, motivated and helpful team working in a dynamic multicultural environment.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to the assigned Host City for the tournament operational period.

title: Finance Officer (LATAM)(m/f/x) - Rio de Janeiro - MSF Belgium
description:
Must be willing to travel for work as needed

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international humanitarian aid organization that provides assistance in more than 70 countries to populations in distress, to victims of natural or manmade disasters and to victims of armed conflicts, without discrimination and irrespective of origin, religion, creed or political affiliation.

CONTEXT

At the heart of the Operations Department in the Operational Centre of Brussels (OCB), the Cells are comprised of a multidisciplinary team of 7 people, including a Coordinator of Operations (CO), Deputy CO, Medical Officer, Human Resources Officer (HRO), Logistic Officer, Finance Officer, Supply Officer and a regional pharmacy advisor working remotely. Their role is to supervise and coordinate MSF activities in several countries. The Cells are the direct interface from HQ to international programmes. We are looking for a Finance Officer for Cell 5, based in Rio de Janeiro, managing the following countries: Haiti, Brazil, Venezuela and Dominican Republic.

As Finance Officer , you play a key strategic role in managing all finance‑and risk‑related domains. Embedded within the Operations Department and working closely with the Finance Department, you act as the Cell financial focal point, fully involved in operational decision‑making and familiar with all projects under the Cell’s portfolio.

As Finance Officer , you are responsible for the financial management of the programmes you oversee. This includes supporting, guiding, and coaching the Financial Coordinators (FinCos), ensuring the quality of management control, budgeting and forecasting, and risk resources management. You guarantee that financial analyses are accurate and aligned with MSF policies and processes. As a referent for FinCos, you promote optimal resource use and contribute to the organisation’s long‑term sustainability.

The countries assigned to the Cell are indicative, as a re‑shuffling of the portfolio within the operations department occurs on a regular basis.

The Finance Officer reports both to the Coordinator of Operations (line manager) and to the Operational Finance Coordinator (functional manager).

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Strategy and Support

Ensure the long‑term sustainability of the finance and risk resources strategies applied in the programmes to complete the constraints related to the shorter‑term assignment for the Finance Coordinators.

Advise, support and challenge the Cell members and CO (Coordinator of Operations) in the management of the operational allocation of resources.

Centralize and lead the programme budget process in close collaboration with Cell members, acting as the guarantor of consistency across yearly and multi‑year budgets.

Collaborate actively in new project proposals, providing financial expertise throughout the process.

Monitor closely the economic indicators of each country and their consequences, ensure that appropriate measures are taken, and oversee their implementation with the Finance Coordinator.

Advise, challenge, and make final decisions on the analytical structure of the budget and accounting (cost centre, budget line, activity, referent), ensuring it is tailored to the strategic orientation, the need operational reporting, and fits the programme’s financial capacity and maturity.

Ensure the pertinence of the Finance team set‑up of the programmes, designing it in line with the operational context, needs and objectives, and adapt the Finance team set‑up according to the evolution of the context and the related risk assessment.

Internal/Quality Control, Standards and Compliance

Contribute actively to the development and upgrade of tools, finance standards, guidelines, and procedures as a key stakeholder.

Ensure that the financial tools, processes and guidelines are relevant, appropriate and are managed according to the MSF OCB standardin the programmes.

Ensure the Programme Finance Guideline is regularly updated and accurate to reflect local compliance requirements, regulation standards, and contextual realities in each programme.

Guide and motivate the Finance Coordinators, and influence the programme and the Cell on risk resource‑management, and compliance analysis as well as on mitigation measures.

Drive the implementation, analysis, and follow‑up of the recommendations of the Internal Control Tool for Finance processes.

Drive the implementation and follow up of internal, external, and national audit recommendations.

Resources Management

Oversee the budget management of the Cell’s portfolio.

Manage the coherence of the multi‑year budget with the project cycle and strategy.

Manage the accuracy of the initial budget by leading the ARO‑MYRO (Annual Review of Operations - Multi‑Year Review of Operation) financial process to its final validation.

Mentor the monthly forecast or quarterly monitoring meeting of projects and programmes by guiding and challenging the programmes in their calculation, projections and analyses.

Ensure the validation process for budget and forecast decision is respected.

Risk resources management of the Cell’s portfolio

Adapt and implement the standard insurance guidelines to the national and legal context.

Implement and regularly review the money security policy, ensuring it is adapted to the operational reality and programme constraints.

Develop and maintain awareness of the anti‑corruption policy and related reporting mechanisms, followed by appropriate measures to ensure compliance.

Ensure the efficiency of the process of programmes provision for litigations and the quality of the information.

Availability of funds in the mission to run the operations

Design and implement in close collaboration with the Finance Coordinators, the finance strategy related means of payment (innovative solutions, online banking, phone banking, hawallah, cash providers, virtual credit cards, etc.).

Review and validate the monthly cash request for the Cell portfolio.

Stakeholders Coordination - Internal and External Communication and Representation

Guarantee efficient communication and a close, effective collaboration with the Programme Accounting Controller overseeing programme accounting support.

Provide the needed information to the Funding Unit related to donor reporting.

Ensure compliance with national fiscal legislation, in collaboration with the ILD (International Legal Department) and other relevant technical departments.

Revise and influence programmes’ agreements involving other sections, procurement centres and international service providers.

Stimulate, maintain, and develop the finance component of intersectional collaboration; promote and uphold mutualisation and harmonisation between sections; and lead the resolution of issues related to finance interoperability among OCs.

Work in close collaboration with the partner section MSF Brazil (MSFBR), especially with its Finance Department, on accounting and tax‑related matters in Brazil, as the position is based in the country and the Cell supports operations locally.

People Management, Supervision and Development

Develop, collaborate on, and facilitate Finance trainings, webinars, and FinCo Weeks.

Anticipate and build the vision for developing key finance staff in programmes, taking into account the national context.

Coach, advise, and develop the competencies of the Financial Coordinators, and provide feedback in close collaboration with their line manager; steer the priority‑setting process in line with departmental strategy; monitor performance along the programme.

Enable a conducive environment within the finance department to foster good team dynamics.

Brief and debrief coordination members before and after their programme deployments.

Treasury Management for the Cell

Manage the Cell’s treasury, including the preparation and submission of the cash request through WeFin.

Oversee the approval of payments, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness.

Manage the Cell’s bank account(s), ensuring proper liquidity levels, reconciliation, and alignment with MSF financial standards and procedures.

Budgeting and Forecasting

Coordinate actively with the HQ Controlling team on budget and forecasting activities, addressing queries related to expense variances and incurred costs at Cell level.

Serve as the primary contact for the HQ Controlling team on budget and forecast matters, regarding, ensuring timely and accurate responses to expense‑related inquiries.

Prepare the Cell’s annual budget in WeFin, in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

Produce and update the Cell’s forecast, ensuring realistic planning and alignment with operational priorities.

Monitor budget execution and provide financial analysis to ensure correct and compliant use of budget lines.

Accounting Follow Up

Monitor the Cell’s accounting, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal policies.

Support and monitor the accurate booking of all expenditures against the appropriate budget lines.

Ensure timely reporting and consolidation of financial information at the regional level.

REQUIREMENTS

Education & Experience

University degree in management, business administration or finance (bachelor’s degree level) or equivalent professional experience.

Minimum 3 years of experience in finance management is mandatory , with MSF or another similar International Humanitarian Organisation (INGO).

Minimum 1 year of International MSF experience in different contexts and interventions , at least one experience as a Financial Coordinator is mandatory .

Capacity to learn and use advanced financial tools.

Strong knowledge in risks resources and internal control management.

Advanced knowledge of Excel, Power BI, MS Office package.

Comprehensive knowledge of humanitarian environment and operations.

Analytical Thinking.

Result‑oriented, with strong problem‑solving skills.

Planning and organising, can work under stress and capacity to prioritize.

Capacity to negotiate, with strong diplomacy and persuasive skills.

Effective in teamwork and collaboration, showing strong awareness of cross‑cultural dynamics.

Flexibility and adaptability.

Demonstrates creativity and innovation, with the capacity to take proactive initiatives.

Languages

Proficiency in English , both written & spoken is mandatory .

  • Proficiency in at least two of the regional languages : French, Spanish, or Portuguese is mandatory .

CONDITIONS

Expected starting date: June 2026

Location: based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Mobility: travel a minimum of 30% per year to the programmes of the Cell’s portfolio and twice a year to HQ in Brussels.

Salary according to MSF salary grid.

The contractual terms, conditions and salary will be established according to the official residence of the selected candidate and in compliance with the standard MSF Brazil function and salary grids.

Family position according to the MSF policy.

Adhere to the MSF principles and to our managerial values: Respect, Transparency, Integrity, Accountability, Trust, and Empowerment

Adhere to the MSF Behavioral Commitments

Deadline for applications: 14 April 2026

Equal Opportunity Statement

MSF values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of disability, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, race, color or ethnic and national origins, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.

Overview

Estamos em busca de uma liderança que entenda que a Ciência de Dados e a Inteligência Artificial são meios, não fins. Como Coordenador(a), seu papel principal não será codar o dia todo, mas sim garantir que nosso time de especialistas tenha clareza de direção, recursos necessários e processos eficientes para entregar soluções que impactem o ponteiro do negócio. Buscamos alguém com visão holística sobre as múltiplas frentes de IA (Generativa, Preditiva, NLP, Visão Computacional), mas que brilhe verdadeiramente na gestão de pessoas.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver o time técnico, garantindo um ambiente de alta performance e colaboração.
  • Gestão de Entregas: Refinar o roadmap da área, priorizando demandas e garantindo que os prazos e a qualidade técnica sejam cumpridos.
  • Interface de Negócios: Traduzir necessidades de stakeholders (muitas vezes não técnicos) em problemas passíveis de solução via Data Science.
  • Curadoria de IA: Atuar como um guia técnico para decidir quando usar modelos tradicionais de Machine Learning ou quando apostar em novas frentes, como LLMs e IA Generativa.
  • Cultura de Dados: Evangelizar o uso ético e eficiente de dados e IA em toda a companhia.
  • Experiência com Liderança: Vivência comprovada na coordenação de equipes técnicas (Cientistas, Engenheiros ou Analistas de Dados).
  • Visão de Projeto: Domínio de metodologias ágeis aplicadas à ciência de dados (como CRISP-DM, Kanban ou Scrum adaptado).
  • Bagagem Técnica: Conhecimento sólido sobre o ciclo de vida de modelos (do EDA ao Deploy/MLOps) para apoiar o time em tomadas de decisão.
  • Familiaridade com o Ecossistema de IA: Entendimento sobre as diversas aplicações de IA (não apenas modelos preditivos, mas também o potencial da IA Generativa e automação).
  • Comunicação Executiva: Capacidade de reportar resultados técnicos de forma clara para diretorias e clientes internos.

Benefícios

  • Para sua saúde e de seus dependentes – Plano de Saúde e Odontológico | Sulamérica.

  • Pacote de alimentação: VA/VR
